title: PackDryRunSampleRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the PackDryRunSampleRecorded platform event (owner ruling INV-Q-4870 B, names pinned by INV-Q-5194; INV-REQ-772 b1, INV-REQ-1303; class: platform): one page of the dry-run sample. The documents array holds at most 500 documents: a document is about 250 bytes of JSON, so a full page is about 125 KB, well below a typical 1 MiB broker message limit with room for the envelope, while a sample of some thousands of documents is still a handful of pages. The cloud-event envelope schema states no size limit, so the bound is chosen here. The tenant is the envelope attribute tenantid (API-40). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

dryRunId.description: The dry run the page belongs to.

lastPage.description: True on the last page of the sample.

entityRef.description: The entity the document belongs to.

internalTaxCode.description: The internal tax code of the document.

precedingDocumentDate.description: Date of the preceding document; credit notes only.

taxableValue.description: Signed taxable value as a decimal string (API-12).

gstValue.description: Signed GST value as a decimal string (API-12).

documents.description: The documents of the page; at most 500 (see the schema description).
